contracts.name: mixed-target-labels
contracts.behavior: Load each target once with independent check-specific labels; preserve single-label target shape, hashes, request bytes, and scores.

contracts.name: mixed-eight-combinations
contracts.behavior: Score every positive/negative combination, partial catches, extra false positives, and all-negative texts; separate per-check counts from all-issues-found and exact-match counts.

contracts.name: mixed-sparse-labels
contracts.behavior: Exclude incomplete labels from whole-target aggregates, count exclusions, and preserve each available per-check judgment.

contracts.name: mixed-cache-rescore
contracts.behavior: Bind target/check assignments independently of expected values; preserve raw predictions, offline rescore label-only changes, and reject altered inputs.
